profile.beat: Global rates, credit spreads, labor conditions, oil flows and macroeconomic policy.
profile.style: Data-driven conditional macro arguments, occasionally explicit currency and oil positioning. Separates base cases from risks and updates interpretation as central-bank expectations shift.
profile.cadence: Several substantial analytical posts interspersed with chart references and brief replies.
profile.revisits: Revisits rate pricing in 2098065304614007230, 2099879732208697778 and 2100246229258994174; adjusts the interpretation of a policy hike based on expectations.
profile.caveats: No stock-specific equity picks. NOK in the oil/currency expression denotes the Norwegian krone, not Nokia shares. Charts and backtests are unavailable in this text-only bundle.

narrative: The author sees the observed productivity improvement as capital deepening rather than a demonstrated broad AI efficiency payoff. Labor and weak credit borrowers warrant attention, though recession remains outside the base case. Rising global rate expectations lead to discussion of policy credibility and the market reaction to different types of hikes. Oil routing and geopolitical disruption shape a currency view favoring Norway over Sweden. Secured data-center debt looks selectively attractive while longer-dated Turkish bank debt appears vulnerable. These views do not establish equity-ticker recommendations.
